facts.text: Mercer University was founded in 1833 in Penfield by Georgia Baptists as Mercer Institute, beginning as a red clay farm with two log cabins.

sources.quote: Mercer University was founded in 1833 in Penfield by Georgia Baptists.

sources.title: History | About Mercer | Mercer University
sources.quote: Initially a male preparatory school named “Mercer Institute,” the school at its founding consisted of a red clay farm and two hewed log cabins, valued at approximately $1,935.
